senses.gloss:
How,Ⓒadv.ⒹkaTaM, kena prakAreRa-rUpeRa.
Ⓑ
 2 kiyat (in ‘how long’, ‘how far’); ‘h(ow) much’ kiyat; ‘h(ow) many’ kati (pl.); ‘h(ow) long’ kiyacciraM, kiyaMtaM kAlaM; ‘h(ow) many kinds’ kativiDAH; ‘h(ow) many times’ katikftvaH; ‘h(ow) now’ nanu, nanu BoH; ‘h(ow) far’ kiyaddUraM, kiyadavaDi; ‘h(ow) much more, -less’ kimuta, kiM punaH, kimu; ‘h(ow) else’ aTa kiM; with adj. ex. by aho; ‘h(ow) pleasing’ aho maDuraM; aho pApaM, &c.

However, Howsoever,Ⓒadv.ⒹyaTAtaTA, yenakena prakAreRa; (with adj.) by api, or by nAma with imp. of verb; ‘h(owsoever) industrious a man may be’ dIrGavyavasAyopi naraH, karotu nAma vyavasAyaM naraH (H. 2).
Ⓔconj.Ⓓ(Howbeit) kiMtu, api tu, tu, paraMtu, taTApi, punaH.

Howl,Ⓒv. i.ⒹAkraMd 1 P, utkruS 1 P, uccEH ras-raw 1 P, garj 1 P, dIrGaM vi-ru 2 P, rE 1 P.
Ⓝ[Howl]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹutkroSaH-SanaM, AkraM-danaM, dIrGarutaM, ArawanaM, ra(rA)vaH, dIrGaravaH, garjanaM, rasitaM; ‘h(owling) of dogs’ BazaRaM, bukkanaM, rAyaRaM.
